title: Create src/tui/components/TaskSelector.tsx
description: Create the Ink TUI component for task selection at the start of a loop session. Shows an 'Auto' option followed by all incomplete tasks. Highlights selected item in cyan.
acceptanceCriteria: 'Auto — pick next incomplete' option appears first
Selected item is highlighted in cyan
Selecting a task calls onSelect with the task object
Selecting Auto calls onSelect with null

steps.details: Create the file. Import React, Box, Text from ink. Import SelectInput from ink-select-input. Import Task from lib/tasks/schema.ts.

export function TaskSelector({ tasks, onSelect }: { tasks: Task[]; onSelect: (task: Task | null) => void }). Build items array: const items = [{ label: 'Auto — pick next incomplete', value: null }, ...tasks.map(t => ({ label: `[#${t.id}] ${t.title}`, value: t }))]
Return: <Box flexDirection='column'><Text bold color='cyan'>Select task to focus on:</Text><SelectInput items={items} onSelect={(item) => onSelect(item.value)} /></Box>
Test by rendering in a test command (or via storybook-like testing) with a mock task array. Confirm Auto appears first and task titles are formatted correctly.

technicalNotes: ink-select-input handles keyboard navigation (arrow keys) automatically
The value: null | Task union requires careful type handling in the onSelect callback
